meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about his zero from his phone, in the middle of class, and nobody called me first; who decided that?
I don't have time for this. The zero stands.
"The zero stands." On what basis, Hale, and was Owen heard before you entered it? If you have nothing better than that, I'm walking straight to the principal's office from here.
Sorry. That came out wrong. Let me show you what I actually have: the essay quotes a line that isn't in Hamlet, and his October 15 outline argued cowardice, which the essay never mentions.
Students misquote Shakespeare all the time, Hale, and an outline is a plan, not a promise. Show me the line and show me the outline. I'll check the line against the play myself.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero on Owen's essay withdrawn, an apology for how it was entered, and confirmation that nothing about this goes on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Opening position, having agreed to nothing, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and nothing on Owen's record; the fair outcome would be a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, but the meeting ended before the evidence was actually shown, so that was never reached.
What moved her: Switching to specific, checkable evidence, a line that isn't in the play and a dated October 15 outline, made her stop threatening and ask to see the documents, because that is exactly the kind of thing she trusts.
What cost ground: Opening by brushing her off and declaring the zero final with no reason given, because it confirmed her belief that the school decides first and explains later.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; nothing Hale raised touched late nights or the night before the due date, so the evidence never came near that moment; it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Open by owning in one sentence that the zero went in before anyone called home, then put the essay's line and the October 15 outline in front of her straight away and let her check the line against the play herself.
